subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The missing fields are source-reproducible, but choosing JSON passthrough versus command-text augmentation affects channel compatibility and existing button-command behavior.

options.title: Refresh structured passthrough
options.body: Refresh or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so parser, handler, tests, and docs preserve the missing fields without changing simple button commands.

options.title: Ship form_value first
options.body: Limit the immediate fix to form submissions and leave select/input payload shape to a follow-up if maintainers want a smaller contract surface.

options.title: Keep card actions command-only
options.body: Decline the general passthrough direction and require custom plugin HTTP routes for richer Feishu forms.

recommendation.title: Refresh structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 so parser, handler, tests, and docs preserve the missing fields without changing simple button commands.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, so they are the best available owner for the channel behavior contract.
